log.text: Hello, I'd like to book a private room at Jade Star Chinese Dining on Wednesday 23 December 2026 at 4pm. Could you please confirm a booking for me?
Welcome to Jade Star Chinese Dining 吉星饭厅. How many guests will there be?

The Orchid Room 兰花厅 is held for the person on Wed 23 Dec 2026 at 4pm for 4 guests, and the code has gone to their phone. They must enter it within 15 minutes to confirm; the RM 100 booking fee is added to the bill at check-out.

data.confirm: The person confirms with the 6-digit code sent by SMS to their phone. No agent can confirm.
